content.description: Top view of cylinder head showing numbered bolt positions and tightening sequence. Numbers range from 1-13, with some positions marked multiple times indicating the tightening sequence order.
Perspective view of cylinder head assembly showing camshaft housing installation

items.text: INSTALL LASH ADJUSTERS AND ROCKER ARMS

subitems.label: (a)
subitems.text: Place new gaskets over dowels on the cylinder head.

subitems.label: (b)
subitems.text: Position the camshaft housing over dowels on the cylinder head.

subitems.label: (c)
subitems.text: Install and tighten the housing nuts and bolts gradually in three passes in the sequence shown. Torque the nuts and bolts on the final pass.

subitems.label: (a)
subitems.text: Install the gaskets to the cylinder heads.

subitems.label: (b)
subitems.text: Place head covers on the camshaft housing and install the seals and screws.
